values: Use this file to review the data structure. The upload screen will be implemented only after you approve this template.
How the future import will work
Prepare — Create project and people records, or fill all tabs in this workbook.
Validate — Upload runs a full validation first. It will show all errors and will not save partial data.
Preview — Review the number of Projects, WBS, work items, and members that will be created.
Confirm — Confirm the import once the preview has no errors.
Audit — The system records created / updated data in Activity log.
Keep Project Code, WBS Code, and Item Code unique within a project.
Work Item Type must be Main Task, Task, or Subtask. Parent Item Code builds the hierarchy.
Use Person ID values from the People master. Multiple assignees are separated by semicolons.
Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. Status Done requires Progress = 100.
Green sample rows are examples only; replace or delete them before upload.
Import action for an existing Project / WBS / Item Code: Create only, Update, or Preview + confirm?
Should a Project be created in the same workbook import, or must it be created first in Project setup?
Should work-item Weight total 100% by WBS, Main Task, or only the whole Project?
Confirm the default roles and statuses in Validation lists.

values: One row = one project. A Project Code links every other worksheet in this file.
One row = one member and role in a Project. Add all people before assigning work items.
One row = one WBS. Parent WBS is optional; leave blank for a top-level WBS.
One row = one Main Task, Task, or Subtask. Use Parent Item Code to create expandable task levels.
Reference values used by drop-down lists. Do not change values until you approve the import rules.
